name: Jamestown (United States)
description: Blue field with a white horizontal band bearing a row of blue blocks like a railway or bridge, charged at the centre with a green lozenge for the town's schools.
history: Jamestown is a town in Guilford County, North Carolina. The flag was adopted in 2018 (designed by Brodie Loman, chosen by the Jamestown Flag Committee in a contest and adopted in August 2018, according to Flags of the World; in 2011 the town had reported having no flag).
